info.name: Petal Wanders API API Documentation
info.description: REST API for the Flower Shop platform. Powers both the storefront and the admin backend. Authentication uses Bearer tokens (Laravel Sanctum); admin endpoints additionally require the `admin` role.

item.name: Admin · Categories
item.description: Category management. Requires an authenticated user with the `admin` role.

item.name: Admin · Orders
item.description: Order oversight and fulfilment. Requires the `admin` role.

request.description: Summary counters for the admin landing page.

item.name: Admin · Products
item.description: Catalog management. Requires an authenticated user with the `admin` role.

item.name: Authentication
item.description:
Register, log in, and manage the current session. Login returns a Bearer
token (Laravel Sanctum) plus the user's roles. Storefront and admin share
this endpoint — authorization is decided by role.

request.description: Create a new customer account and return an API token.
Authenticate with email + password. Works for both customers and admins.
Return the authenticated user and their roles.
Revoke the token used for the current request.

item.name: Catalog
item.description: Public, read-only catalog endpoints consumed by the storefront.

item.name: Orders
item.description: Customer order endpoints. Requires authentication; users only see their own orders.

request.description:
Creates an order from a list of product/quantity pairs. Prices and stock
are validated server-side; the request only supplies product ids + quantities.
